name: Case law: Poland, the Krajowa Izba Odwoławcza (National Appeal Chamber)
label: Poland case law (the Krajowa Izba Odwoławcza (National Appeal Chamber))
coverage: 22168 judgments with text from SAOS, one file and one commit each, dated the day given; 9957 citations of law linked to poland-law.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day given. Judgments with no usable date are in decisions/undated/.
